PCS Alphabetic Index

Source: R/index.R
index.Rd

The Alphabetic Index maps clinician-documented terminology to PCS tables and codes.

Usage

index(term = NULL)

Arguments

term

<chr> term to search for

Value

a tibble::tibble containing the results

Details

Unlike the ICD-10-CM index, most entries do not end at a complete code. Rather, they point to a PCS table or row (the first three or four characters), and the coder completes the remaining characters inside that table. Look up the term, follow it to the table, then build and verify the full seven-character code on its code page.

Examples

index("Abdominohysterectomy")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   entry letter term                 field     value             source          
#>   <int> <chr>  <chr>                <chr>     <chr>             <chr>           
#> 1     6 A      Abdominohysterectomy see       Resection, Uterus mainTerm/see    
#> 2     6 A      Abdominohysterectomy see/codes 0UT9              mainTerm/see/co…
index("Attain Ability")
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   entry letter term                   field   value                       source
#>   <int> <chr>  <chr>                  <chr>   <chr>                       <chr> 
#> 1   236 A      Attain Ability(R) lead level   1                           mainT…
#> 2   236 A      Attain Ability(R) lead use     Cardiac Lead, Pacemaker in  mainT…
#> 3   236 A      Attain Ability(R) lead use/tab 02H                         mainT…
#> 4   236 A      Attain Ability(R) lead level   1                           mainT…
#> 5   236 A      Attain Ability(R) lead use     Cardiac Lead, Defibrillato… mainT…
#> 6   236 A      Attain Ability(R) lead use/tab 02H                         mainT…
index("arthr*")
